items.title: 10.2.2 Compound ya radical mein element ka oxidation number nikalna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2.2 with Samples 10.1 to 10.3, printed pages 215-216.

blocks.text: Compound ya radical mein kisi atom ka oxidation number oopar ke usoolon se milta hai. Metal aur non-metal ke compounds mein metal ka oxidation number hamesha musbat aur non-metal ka manfi hota hai: sodium sulfide Na2S mein 2(+1) + S = 0, to S = -2. Do mukhtalif non-metals ke compounds mein nishan electronegativity par munhasir hai, sab se zyada electronegative element manfi nishan leta hai.
Har O atom -2 hai, to do oxygen atoms 2 x (-2) = -4 dete hain. SO2 par koi charge nahi, to kul sifar hai: S + 2(-2) = 0, S - 4 = 0, S = +4.
Compound ions do ya zyada mukhtalif atoms wale ions hain, jaise sulfate ion SO4 2- aur nitrate ion NO3-. Sulfate ke liye [S ka Ox. No.] + 4 [O ka Ox. No.] = -2, to S + 4(-2) = -2 aur S = +6.
(K ka Ox. No.) + (Mn ka Ox. No.) + 4 (O ka Ox. No.) = 0, to +1 + Mn + 4(-2) = 0, +1 + Mn - 8 = 0, yani Mn - 7 = 0, Mn = +7.

blocks.prompt: CrCl3, Cr2(SO4)3 aur Cr2O7 2- mein chromium ka oxidation number nikalein (exercise Q.2f).

items: Metal non-metal ke saath: metal musbat (Na2S: S -2). Do non-metals: zyada electronegative manfi. SO2: S +4; SO4 2-: S +6; KMnO4: Mn +7.
